method: One identical closed-world public-data task per native Codex worker, run concurrently. Each worker reads only task.json, writes its assigned JSON and does not inspect other responses. Mechanical scoring uses the frozen score.py; next_measurement is archived but not scored.
quality_bar: Correct classification of all ten claims, both reduced fractions, unit and criterion_5 flag: 14/14.
scope_limits: No N/SDD/T method arms, independent replicates, reserved case, blind human judges or interventions.
The shared filesystem and instructions do not technically prevent cross-run reading.
Native agent outputs do not expose authenticated effective model, token, time or cost telemetry to this experiment.
